name: robots/anki__cozmo-python-sdk
title: Anki Cozmo robot (cozmo.robot.Robot)
intro: Anki Cozmo robot (cozmo.robot.Robot), adapted from anki/cozmo-python-sdk. It reads `head_angle`, `lift_ratio`, `lift_height`, `is_charging` and 1 more; runs `move_head`, `set_lift_ratio` and `stop_all`. `move_head`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
